headline: Fed's Favorite Inflation Gauge Hits 3-Year High, Fueling Rate-Hike Bets (UPDATED)
summary: PCE inflation rose further in May, reinforcing bets the Fed hikes rates by October as Chair Kevin Warsh keeps policy tight to cool prices.

headline: Micron Rallies 15%, Apple Sinks 6% On Memory Costs: Stock Market Today
summary: Micron's blowout earnings powered memory and chip stocks higher, but the broad stock market rally stalled by midday as S&P 500 slipped.
